message: This is a flat isometric 2D map. Elevation, 3D cameras and terrain meshes are not represented.

Preview uses four-neighbour grid BFS with the configured actor footprint and independent static object collision polygons. It does not generate a navigation mesh or continuous CharacterBody2D movement.
Spawn, exit, trigger and interaction IDs are retained. Enter exits/triggers or press E beside interactions to emit marker_entered; connect game-specific actions yourself.
